preToolUse.bash: if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/copilot-mention-guard.py"; else exit 0; fi
preToolUse.powershell: if (-not $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $py = Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $py) { exit 0 }; & $py.Source (Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\copilot-mention-guard.py')
